findings.claim: The new `PermissionDenied` mapping does not compile because it passes `&String` to `Status::permission_denied`, which expects an `Into<String>` value.
findings.evidence: Hunk changes `PortError::PermissionDenied(message) => Status::permission_denied(message)`, where matching on `&PortError` binds `message` as `&String`; constraint R1 requires `cargo check --workspace` to be clean.

findings.claim: The change touches Rust/config/docs but includes no OpenSpec delta for the target change.
findings.evidence: Constraint P1 requires each change to carry a `specs/<capability>/spec.md` delta so `openspec validate <id>` passes; the diff contains no `openspec/changes/pri-c009-entity-projection/.../spec.md` changes.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the required OpenSpec spec delta with ADDED/MODIFIED sections and scenarios, then validate `pri-c009-entity-projection`.

findings.claim: The required source-bound acceptance receipt is missing from the diff.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 5 requires saving a source-bound receipt under `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/production-readiness-integration/evidence/pri-c009-entity-projection/`, but the diff contains no files under that evidence path.
